data.name: Faq_Eyebrow
data.value: FAQ

data.name: Faq_Title
data.value: Frequently asked questions

data.name: Faq_Intro
data.value: Short and honest answers. Your question isn't here? Register and try it out.

data.name: Faq_App_Q
data.value: Do my guests need an app?

data.name: Faq_App_A
data.value: No. The QR code opens your menu directly in the phone's browser. There is nothing to install and no account to create.

data.name: Faq_Cost_Q
data.value: What does Speise-Direkt cost?

data.name: Faq_Cost_A
data.value: Registration is free.
data.comment: Exactly this, nothing more (no prices are defined)

data.name: Faq_SameCode_Q
data.value: Does the QR code stay the same when I change the menu?

data.name: Faq_SameCode_A
data.value: Yes. The QR code leads to your menu, not to a particular version of it. You change dishes, prices and photos in the admin area; your guests see the change the next time they open the menu.

data.name: Faq_Schedule_Q
data.value: Can a QR code show a different menu depending on the time?

data.name: Faq_Schedule_A
data.value: Yes. With a time table, the same QR code shows, for example, the lunch menu at noon and the evening menu at night. In the calendar you set single days, periods or fixed weekdays – such as the Christmas menu or fish Friday.

data.name: Faq_Allergens_Q
data.value: How do I show allergens?

data.name: Faq_Allergens_A
data.value: You add the 14 EU allergens with one click and assign them to your dishes. Guests see them with the dish and can hide dishes with certain allergens.

data.name: Faq_Languages_Q
data.value: Is the menu available in several languages?

data.name: Faq_Languages_A
data.value: Yes, as language versions: you create a copy of your menu in another language, translate the texts yourself and link both. Guests switch the language with one tap. There is no automatic translation.

data.name: Faq_Ordering_Q
data.value: Can guests order or pay through the menu?

data.name: Faq_Ordering_A
data.value: No, Speise-Direkt is a menu, not an ordering system. Guests can collect dishes on a favourites list that is stored only on their phone, and then order from the staff as usual.

data.name: Faq_Team_Q
data.value: Can several people manage the menu?

data.name: Faq_Team_A
data.value: Yes. You invite staff with their own login and use roles and permissions to decide who may see and change what.

data.name: Faq_Print_Q
data.value: How does the QR code get onto the table?

data.name: Faq_Print_A
data.value: You download every QR code as a PNG and print it yourself – for table stands, stickers or the shop window.
